keyPhrases.text: Listen up. Time to put down the knitting, the book, and the broom and hie on over
slithery, at times lascivious choreography, set the mood
extensively and presumably quite expensively reconfigured

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic recommendation ('Listen up... hie on over'). Praises the staging, direction, performances, and Redmayne's interpretation. Notes the production's Olivier Awards and expensive reconfiguration. Some minor reservations about pricing and comparison to previous productions, but overall very favorable assessment puts this in 4/5 star range.
